digest.component_or_area: reconciler apply and subprocess runtime scoping
propositions: Write/apply and subprocess paths currently reuse broad parent environments and rebuild config instead of using S2 operation bindings, risking unintended scope writes and credential leakage to unrelated siblings.

Jira Cloud scope has implicit DIG fallbacks in four locations (write path, live access-check probe, runtime default, create-time default) that can execute requests under unintended scope when project is unset.

Child processes and environment projection lack a scoped runtime model; trusted same-capability children, owning children with adapter overlays, and unrelated siblings cannot be safely isolated without mutating global os.environ.
Environment projection registry and child-environment builder must prevent secret name leakage across Rebar adapters while preserving unknown native Git/SSH/AWS/proxy/CA variables for legitimate use.

Elimination of all implicit DIG defaults requires fail-closed typed errors at pre-mutation and pre-probe points, ensuring DIG is used only when explicitly configured and never as an implicit fallback.
